sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r13/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 35 = check 34; Internal Quality Checks row 35, no extra annotation beyond the check text)
qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/tests/editor.cjs and polish.cjs (relevant checks), results/polish.json, results/runtime.json, results/golden-1440.png, results/golden-390.png
evidence:
WHAT IS DONE WELL (most of the row is satisfied by the wording): every scored dimension starts with a live gate that types into the editor, and the prompts demand real input ('Use real browser interaction: real key presses and mouse clicks', functional/prompt.md and polish/prompt.md Action rules; 'Where waiting is required, wait the stated time; do not shorten it', functional/prompt.md). Waits are written into the time-varying criteria: cw_stop_cancels_pending_work and cw_newer_run_supersedes ('Then wait at least eight more seconds'), cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget ('wait at least eight more seconds so the original five seconds have long passed'), cw_time_limit_recovery ('within about ten seconds a visible time-limit reason must appear'), cw_live_library_update ('without reloading or pressing anything in A, watch its library for up to ten seconds'), cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft (ten-second baseline wait, then ten-second window). Viewport: polish cw_narrow_width_usable says 'Resize the browser viewport to about 390 by 844 pixels and reload ... type a short line in the editor and see it appear, and press the Run control ... Restore the desktop viewport afterwards'. State toggles: cw_undo_redo_availability, cw_unsaved_marker, cw_focus_returns_to_code and cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus all require actions before each observation. Visual is not a still first paint: visual/prompt.md fixes 'a desktop viewport of about 1440 by 900 pixels', requires a ten-line draft and one Run, then 'click once into the code and watch the caret for about two seconds, because a caret may blink', and a double-click selection before the other screenshots. The app has no theme toggle or required animation, so nothing themed is left unexercised. On the EARLIER hosted candidate (not these bytes) the judge reasoning shows it really did these things: 'Viewport resized to 390x844 and reloaded: document.scrollingElement reported scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth 390', 'Stop was pressed 146ms after Run ... After 9s, STOP-MARK/STOP-TIMER/STOP-INTERVAL never appeared', 'a thin light caret was visible ... in three consecutive 120 ms clips and absent in the fourth'. No configured judge run exists for these bytes, so that is supporting evidence only.

DEFECT (time-varying behaviour not exercised): environment/instructions/ui.md states a duration-dependent requirement: 'A continuous multi-caret typing burst is one Undo action; Redo restores it. The burst lasts for as long as I keep typing at those carets, however slowly, and ends only when a caret moves or I do something else.' The only criterion that grades it, tests/scored/functional/judge.toml cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic (weight 2.0), says: 'Type the five characters MULTI as normal sequential keys, without moving a caret or doing anything else in between; pauses between the keys do not matter. ... One Undo must remove all fifteen inserted characters'. It tells the judge that pauses are irrelevant but never tells it to pause, so the 'however slowly' half of the promise is observed only if the judge happens to press the keys in separate slow tool calls. No other criterion covers it (cw_same_line_carets: 'Undo behaviour is not judged here'). The scripted golden does not exercise it either: qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/tests/editor.cjs:154 is 'await page.keyboard.type(\'MULTI\');' with no delay.

SECONDARY NOTE (not the basis of the Fail): cw_visual_workspace_layout asks for 'the arrangement of the editor, preview, console, library and main controls' at desktop size without telling the judge to scroll or take a full-page capture; the golden fits in 1440x900 (results/golden-1440.png) so it is unaffected, but a taller conforming layout would be scored from whatever is above the fold. Also cw_narrow_width_usable only requires that Run 'can be pressed' at 390 px, which is deliberate ('scored elsewhere') and acceptable.
counterexample: Broken app that can pass: an editor that groups multi-caret typing into one Undo step by an idle timer (for example a new undo group after 500-1000 ms without a key, a very common implementation). It violates ui.md ('however slowly'). If the judge types MULTI with one Playwright type call or its code runner (page.keyboard.type, explicitly allowed by app_context.md), the five keys arrive milliseconds apart, one Undo removes all fifteen characters and the criterion passes at weight 2.0. The same app fails when the judge happens to send five separate key-press tool calls seconds apart, so the verdict for identical bytes depends on the judge's incidental input method rather than on the app. Conforming alternative is not harmed; the defect is a false pass and run-to-run variance.
suggested_fix: In cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic replace 'pauses between the keys do not matter' with an explicit wait, e.g. 'type MUL, wait about three seconds without touching the mouse or any other key, then type TI', keeping the one-Undo/one-Redo bar; and add the same pause to the scripted golden check so the reference is measured on it.
